kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-trend --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --start-time 1672502400 --end-time 1725966000 --cluster-id 433 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveOutboundTrend

parameters.help_en:

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.
> Compliance review currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. Make sure the time range is valid
